purpose: Resolve the preregistered Guitar sparsePursuit clause without professional-reference access, candidate output, score feedback, threshold sweep, or variant selection. The previously landed transcriber blob 5617ff1a6ea301ecaeb898b123b05d2a8c915388 is a non-executable setup draft until replaced by code that implements this resolution.

consistencyFinding.issue: The architecture preregistration requires iterative non-overlapping residual-template selection, while the sealed numeric implementation contract defines persistent three-frame candidates and max-six addition but omits the residual-selection mechanics.
consistencyFinding.resolutionType: setup-only deterministic clarification preserving the preregistered architecture

sparsePursuitNumerics.candidatePool: Only MIDI values satisfying the sealed persistentTrackRule: candidate ranks in the six highest harmonic-template scores independently in every one of the three consecutive frames centered on the independent guitar-onset frame.
sparsePursuitNumerics.residualRepresentation: A private copy of the same three-frame log1p(abs(CQT)) magnitudes already specified by the sealed harmonic-template contract.
sparsePursuitNumerics.templateBins: For each candidate MIDI, union the radius-1 CQT-bin neighborhoods around harmonics 1..5 using the sealed 36 bins/octave representation and sealed harmonic frequencies.
sparsePursuitNumerics.candidateGain: Evaluate the sealed harmonic-template score on the current residual over the three analysis frames: sum(weight_h * mean(residual bins for harmonic h)) + 0.75 * fundamentalMeanResidual.
sparsePursuitNumerics.selectionOrder: At each iteration choose the remaining candidate with greatest positive candidateGain; ties within 1e-12 choose lower MIDI.
sparsePursuitNumerics.nonOverlapRule: A candidate is ineligible after any previously selected candidate if their templateBins intersect.
sparsePursuitNumerics.residualSubtraction: After selection, set the selected candidate's templateBins to zero in the private residual copy for all three analysis frames; no other bins are modified.
sparsePursuitNumerics.stopRule: Stop after six selected MIDI values, when no eligible candidate remains, or when the greatest eligible candidateGain is <= 0.
sparsePursuitNumerics.eventCreation: For each selected MIDI not within 60 ms of an existing same-MIDI Basic Pitch or harmonic-track event, create one harmonic_track event of exactly 0.07 seconds at the independent guitar onset.

canonicalizationRule: This resolution must be pinned in the V158 pre-run identity receipt together with the final transcriber and independent structural-QC blobs. No V158 generation workflow may exist before that pinning.
